en.headline: how to avoid claude account bans with a dual-layer network setup
en.summary: After being banned six times, the author built a reliable network using a US VPS and static residential IP to access Claude without getting blocked.
points: Used BandwagonHost VPS with CN2 GIA for fast, stable connection to the US.
Connected to Surflare's AT&T static residential IP for clean, low-risk exit point.
Configured chain proxy so local devices use VPS as gateway, which then routes traffic through residential IP.
Achieved 98/100 IP purity score and 12% risk level, with latency around 160–180ms.
All home devices (Mac, iPhone, router) work seamlessly without changing settings.

zh.headline: 連續六次被Claude封號後的最終解決方案
zh.summary: 作者在被封號六次後，透過搭建搬瓦工VPS加AT&T美國住宅IP的雙層網絡，成功避免再被封號。
points: 使用搬瓦工CN2 GIA機房VPS，確保國內連接快速穩定。
搭配Surflare提供的AT&T美國住宅靜態IP，出口IP純淨度高、風險極低。
在VPS上設置鏈式代理，本地設備無需更改設定，流量自動轉發至住宅IP。
測試顯示IP評分達98分，風險值僅12%，延遲約160至180毫秒。
全屋設備（包括手機、電腦、路由器）均可無感使用，實現透明代理。

en.headline: Claude account protection guide for 2026
en.summary: A detailed guide explains how to protect Claude accounts from being banned by managing environment, payment, behavior, and settings.
points: Set device time zone to Taipei and disable automatic time zone setting on both computer and phone.
Use a dedicated residential IP with ISP type, not hosting, and avoid shared or proxy IPs.
Enable TUN mode in proxy software to prevent WebRTC and DNS leaks.
Use one account per device and browser profile, avoid multiple logins or third-party clients.
Pay via App Store if possible for easier refunds; avoid virtual cards and sudden Max upgrades.

zh.headline: 2026年Claude防封實用指南
zh.summary: 文章詳述如何透過環境、支付、使用行為及設定四層防線，保護Claude帳號免遭封禁。
points: 電腦與手機時區設為台北，關閉自動設定時區功能。
選用獨享住宅IP，確保出口IP類型為ISP而非機房，避免跳節點。
啟用代理軟體的TUN模式，防止WebRTC和DNS洩漏真實IP。
一個帳號只限一台設備及一個瀏覽器資料夾使用，避免多帳號登陸或接第三方客戶端。
付款優先選擇App Store內購以便退款，避免新號直接升級Max或使用虛擬卡。

en.headline: claude blocks hk users why vpn not clean
en.summary: Claude blocks Hong Kong users not just because of VPN use but due to overall device and network environment.
points: VPN use alone does not guarantee account ban
Clean IP does not ensure safety from bans
Claude analyzes device and network environment for fraud detection
Multiple factors beyond VPN affect account status
Article explains technical reasons behind bans, not how to avoid them

zh.headline: Claude 大規模封香港用戶 真係因為你個 VPN唔乾淨
zh.summary: Claude 封鎖香港用戶並非單因使用 VPN，而是綜合分析裝置及網絡環境所致。
points: 僅使用 VPN 不會直接導致帳號被封
所謂「乾淨 IP」不代表一定安全
Claude 會檢測裝置與網絡環境以判斷風險
帳號狀態受多種因素影響，不限於 VPN
本文純技術角度解釋封號原因，不提供防封方法
